correctness.rationale: For all n,r>=1, shattering pairwise same-block equality supports under partitions with blocks of size≤r is equivalent to a forest with all components size≤r: cycles force transitivity contradiction, and a larger positive component exceeds the cap; every forest labeling is realized by grouping positive-edge components. The labeled tree exponential formula yields the face polynomial. The union-find predictor merges at most n-ceil(n/r) times, matching a spanning-forest VC witness. A forest facet precisely forbids merging any two components, hence all component size pairs have sum>r. Sorting sizes gives minimum total t*(floor(r/2)+1) minus 1 if r even, and monotone increments fill every intermediate feasible n; resulting gap-free facet-size interval as stated, including r=1, r≥n. Independently checked n4 cap2, n5 cap3 traces, and all 120 n<=15,r<=8 maximal-component cardinality intervals.

broader_coverage.reasoning: The broader refinement-closed theorem gives support faces and capacity rank, but no closed all-r facet-count-size interval. The fixed-q graphic matroid theorem gives only pure maximal faces in a different family. Classical labeled-tree EGF can derive counting once the face criterion is known, but does not by itself imply the parity-sensitive facet interval.
